title:
【不具合の報告内容】
テキスト入力欄で文字が一切タイピングできなくなる
body:
【不具合の報告内容】
iPad Airにて、Apple純正キーボード（カバー一体型タイプ）を接続してアプリを使用していますが、一昨日（10月3日頃）からテキスト入力欄で文字が一切タイピングできなくなる致命的な不具合が発生しています。
• 発生環境: iPad Air ／ 純正外部キーボード接続時
• 具体的な症状:
	• テキスト入力欄（文字入れ枠）をタップしても、キーボードからの入力が一切反応しません。
	• 画面の長押しによる「ペースト（貼り付け）」や、キーボードショートカット（Command+V）での貼り付けも完全に拒否され、文字入力画面がフリーズしたような状態になります。
	• iPadの縦向き変更やアプリの再インストール、再起動、予測入力のオフなど、端末側のあらゆる対処法を試しましたが改善しません。
他の一般アプリ（Google等）では正常にキーボード入力ができているため、直近のアプリのアップデート、またはiPadOSとの互換性によるバグだと考えられます。お仕事で使用しており、現在全く作業にならず非常に困っております。一刻も早い修正アップデートの配信を強くお願いいたします

title: 最高の日記！！
body:
純正アプリで日記に最適です！
スマホで書いても
iPadで書いても同期できるので、
どちらで書いても一つにまとめられるのは嬉しいです！
紙で書いていると限りがありますが、
このようにデジタル上に書くことで、かさばらず無限にかけます！また、あの日何したのかとか、どこへ行ったのかなどを指でスクロールするだけで思い出を一目で見返すことができます！
ジャーナル上では、
現在地の位置情報をボタン一つで記録したり、
写真を撮った場所をカメラが記録してるので、
それを元にこれもボタン一つで追加できます。
ボイスメッセージも追加できるので、
文字を書かかずとも言葉で残すこともできます。
またジャーナル上では、AIによっておすすめが表示され、何を書こうかわからない人でも、とりあえずで始めることができます。
他には、連続記録というものがあり、書いていればいるほど、この数字が積み上がっていくのが楽しくなってきます。たとえズボラでも、また日記を書く習慣がなくとも、きっと、とりあえずで一枚は埋められます！
どんな感情やどんなくだらないことであっても、それは最高の宝物です。
今という最高の思い出を残してみてはいかがでしょうか？

もちろん。レビューとして自然で、感情は伝えつつも具体性が伝わる形なら、こうまとめられます。

今回、かなり期待して利用しましたが、正直とても残念でした。
特に専門的な内容について相談した際、最初の回答に現実的ではない提案があり、こちらが指摘すると後から「最初からこう考えるべきだった」と説明される流れになりました。

以前から同じように、回答の間違いやズレを指摘すると「最初からこうするべきだった」と言われることが多いのですが、毎回その説明を聞いても、実際の回答の精度が改善されているようには感じません。

今回は回答を信頼して相談していた分、期待しすぎた自分にも問題があったのかもしれませんが、結果的に課金したことが無駄に感じるだけでなく、確認や訂正に時間を使うことになり、時間まで無駄になりました。

AIだから間違えること自体は理解しています。ただ、専門的な相談に対して自信のあるような回答をした後、指摘されてから後付けで説明を修正するのではなく、最初から不確かな部分を明確にした上で、根拠のある回答をしてほしいです。

期待していた分、今回のやり取りにはかなり失望しました。
author: mmhmna

title: Used to be Great, Now? Not Nearly as Good
body:
This used to be an awesome app and was easy to get gift cards with your points and it didn’t feel as intrusive and corrupt as many of the other apps that are kind of similar. Less of the two evils, so to speak… 

but ever since you (Fetch) added extra “stuff” (shop online to get points, play games you have to download to get points, etc), it’s going downhill in my opinion. 

I liked it because I didn’t have to download stupid games I don’t want to play (I don’t want to download more apps and I don’t want to play games!) 

You all (Fetch) are profiting from us in multiple ways, double and triple (etc.) dipping, without paying us more and that’s unethical. It doesn’t matter that other apps do it. Does that make it right bc others are doing it? No!). 

You (Fetch) are already getting our personal info by seeing everything we purchase via receipts and our online shopping accounts and receipts from email if we choose to give you access, and you’re  selling the info to god knows who and paying us peanuts for it. 

And even that wasn’t enough. You wanted more for less. So you added games and online shopping through your app so you all get paid more and more every time you add a new “feature/ways to earn,” when in reality, it takes us longer to earn and YOU’RE the one getting “new ways to earn!”

Also have a problem with the vague instructions for games. There is very little direction and why I’m not loaded in points right now is beyond me bc I’ve passed several milestones/levels on multiple games and never got my points for them. I also didn’t get points at all on a few games and when I look at them a few days after playing, there’s a vague notification saying I wasn’t eligible to play that game for payment bc I’d already downloaded it before or the incentive was over with yet no one bothered to warn me before I wasted time downloading and playing them, that they weren’t active games anymore (they still said they were in the app and when I played, so that’s wrong. PLUS, to just tell me “you didn’t get points bc you’ve already played the games before is not only wrong but it’s super shady and evil bc I absolutely had not played these games before! 

Lastly, the points are not being added consistently or accurately and no one can tell me why and no one escalates the problem to someone above who can actually help, no one offers to escalate it or look into it, which is fraud. 

One more thing: the gift card drawings that we can use our points to enter every so often: 

Does anyone actually win? I mean, you can put names down, but we don’t know if these people even exist, we don’t know if they won anything, we don’t know if our entries are actually being submitted for said prize or we’re just pi$$ing away our points so you all don’t have to pay us out. I have a strong suspicion of what it is, but of course no one will ever admit to it.

Again, this used to be a great app, but it’s gone downhill very very quickly ever since you (Fetch) decided to get greedier. Shame…

title: Not enough programmable options
body:
I have started and stopped this program several times. Mostly because the programming is so annoying. I would like options such as being able to listen to each sentence in the desired language and it is available. Sometimes the translations to my native tongue are awkward sentences.. Additionally, there are words that are completely useless to me or words that I know very well that I do not need reinforced. And other words that I would like to focus on more that are not presented frequently enough. There is not enough repetition immediately to reinforce certain concepts.

I’ve been playing chess lately And there are several problems here as well. When I am playing a match, the computer makes really stupid moves. No sane person who knows anything about chess would make those moves.. Therefore, I do not think it is a really good teacher. It’s OK to learn the basics, but not to learn anything beyond that so far

Another problem with chess:: when I’m playing a match and I’m about to put myself into checkmate, in the early stages of the app, a warning would be nice!!  Also, when in a lesson and there are options for moves, if I choose something that the Oscar doesn’t prefer, I’m not told why.  If I were told why, I could learn.  And, play better.  Otherwise, I’m becoming a programmed robot.  
How dumb!!

body: TikTok developers urgently need to optimize memory usage for mobile game streaming on iOS. Currently, streaming high-performance games causes the broadcast to instantly crash with a "Stream URL Error" whenever you open the in-app chat drawer during gameplay. This occurs because iOS caps screen recording extensions (ReplayKit) at a strict 50MB RAM limit, and rendering the live chat overlay forces the app over this ceiling, causing iOS to terminate the broadcast extension. The exact same account and settings work flawlessly on Android devices without any crashes. Please release an update for iOS that optimizes ReplayKit memory allocation and reduces overlay memory consumption so creators can manage chat without losing their stream!
